currentPhase: v0.3.5 — findability and self-documentation: real exe icon, About panel, agent ritual, Electron smoke test, local docs site with mind maps, gated web mirror.
next: Port Nebula Demo features into the rewrite one at a time via the bus/disk-store/storage hooks: graph, flashcards, command palette, search, i18n.

repository.whyPublic: electron-updater reads latest.yml from the release page with no credentials; a private repo would mean compiling a GitHub token into every copy of the app.

quality.smokeCommand: npm run build && npm run smoke

invariants: The dev app and the installed app never share a profile — npm run dev sets NEBULA_USER_DATA to <repo>/.dev-profile.
Sample notes are seeded only when the vault was read successfully AND came back empty. An unreadable vault disables the disk mirror instead.
The vault is copied to backups/pre-update-<version>-<time> immediately before an update installs.
electron-updater stays in dependencies and external in vite.config.js; CI asserts both latest.yml and its presence in the asar.
win.signAndEditExecutable must stay unset — false also disables rcedit, which is what writes the exe's icon and version info.

history.what: Exe icon and version metadata (rcedit re-enabled), AppUserModelId, About panel with build channel and folders, agent ritual (AGENTS/preflight/memory/Prompt/HANDOVER/tests), 22-check Electron smoke test, local docs site with six mind maps, gated nebula-web mirror published on every release.
Sidebar mark drawn as one closed arc path — two circles with fill-rule evenodd cannot subtract and rendered a ring.

First public release: GitHub Releases for Windows and macOS, in-app updates (silent install on Windows, notify+download elsewhere), and three data-loss fixes — shared dev/installed profile, seeding over an unreadable vault, no pre-update snapshot.
Editor v3: movable editing bar, line icons, markdown code blocks with syntax colours, free-floating shapes, tabbed AI panel, six seed notes.
